name: Cassette Futurism
summary: Bulky hardware from a future imagined on tape: CRT monitors, membrane keys, toggle switches and beige casings, with amber or green phosphor text. It draws on Syd Mead's industrial futures and Japanese bubble-era electronics. The look is functional, worn and a little cramped.

philosophy.core_thesis: The future is a machine with visible switches: every function has a physical control, a label and a status light, and the casing shows the wear of use.
design_principles: Set text in phosphor amber (#FFB000) or green (#33FF66) on a near-black ground (#14130F) with contrast of 9:1 or more.
Build panels as casings in beige (#D8D0B8) or grey (#9A9A8E) with a 4px radius, a 2px dark border and a 1px light top edge.
Label each control in upper-case mono at 12px with +0.08em tracking, and place the label above the control.
Group controls in bays on a 12-column grid with 16px gutters; separate bays with a 2px groove.
Add a status light of 8px, a toggle switch, a segment display or a cassette window to each major panel.
Frame the main screen as a CRT: 8% corner radius, a 1px inner glow and scanlines of 2px at 8% opacity.
Add print marks to casings: part numbers, arrows, and one hazard stripe of 8px in orange (#E8662B) or yellow.
anti_patterns: Rounded pill buttons with soft shadows
Hidden controls behind icons with no label
Clean white surfaces with no wear
Sleek, seamless hardware with no visible switches

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid of equipment bays with 16px gutters; each bay is a panel with a 2px groove between it and the next.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left labels above controls; numeric readouts right-aligned; panels align to a common baseline of 8px.
layout.container_geometry: Casings with a 4px radius, a 2px border and a 1px highlight on the top edge; screens with an 8% radius; round 8px status lights.

font_pairings.note: An angular technical display face with a plain mono text face.
A wide display face for panel titles with a mono readout face.
A narrow label face with a pixel terminal face for screens.

hierarchy_rules: Set display and labels in upper case.
Put readouts and data in mono; put panel titles in the display face.

color.palette_structure: A near-black screen ground with two phosphor colours, on beige and grey casings with one orange warning mark.
color.contrast_rules: Phosphor text on tube black holds 9:1 or more; text on beige casings uses tube black at 12:1.
color.surface_treatment: Matte, slightly speckled casings (noise at 4% opacity); flat screen grounds with scanlines at 8% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: A 1px light top edge and a 2px dark bottom edge give each casing its bulk; screens carry a 6px to 12px phosphor glow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Moulded plastic casings, membrane keys, rubber-capped toggles and glass CRT screens.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px dark border on casings; a 2px groove between bays; a 1px inner border on screens.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No backdrop blur; keys rise by 2px to 4px with a hard shadow; the glow on text is 6px to 12px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Heavy solid glyphs at 24px on square tiles, in the style of panel symbols: arrows, power, record, eject.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Industrial vehicles, control rooms and orbital stations drawn with airbrush gradients; wireframe grids in green or amber.

motion.transition_physics: Mechanical and stepped: panels switch on in 3 to 5 steps; text types in at 40ms per character; a CRT flicker of 2% runs every 8s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lights the status light and raises the key by 2px; active presses the key down by 2px and shows the phosphor colour.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the weight of a working machine and a future that smells of warm plastic.

use_cases: developer tools with a terminal character
avoid_when: The audience needs a calm, consumer-grade interface.
The page has long reading text on a light ground.
The product is touch-first and needs large soft targets.

modifiers.how: Remove the screen glow, hazard stripes and part numbers; keep the grid, the labels and one accent colour.
Replace amber and green with pink and cyan on deep violet; keep the windows and add a perspective grid.
Add leather and brushed-metal textures and 8px to 16px soft shadows; keep the labelled controls.

pack.why: Square, blocky glyphs match the panel symbols and the pixel screens of the period.

ground.why: Cassette futurism lives on a phosphor screen with visible scan lines and a dark bezel.
